),
weekly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    yr.year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cs.week_date = yr.before1 THEN cs.sales ELSE 0 END) as before1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cs.week_date = yr.before2 THEN cs.sales ELSE 0 END) as before2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cs.week_date = yr.before3 THEN cs.sales ELSE 0 END) as before3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cs.week_date = yr.before4 THEN cs.sales ELSE 0 END) as before4,

    SUM(CASE WHEN cs.week_date = yr.after4 THEN cs.sales ELSE 0 END) as after4
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales cs
  CROSS JOIN year_ref yr

      '2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08',
      '2020-05-18', '2020-05-25', '2020-06-01', '2020-06-08',
      '2020-06-15', '2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06'
    )
  GROUP BY yr.year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  ref_week,
  ROUND(before1 + before2 + before3 + before4, 2) as total_before,

  ROUND(100.0 * (after1 + after2 + after3 + after4 - (before1 + before2 + before3 + before4)) / (before1 + before2 + before3 + before4), 2) as pct_change
FROM weekly_totals
ORDER BY year

WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    week_number,
    SUM(sales) as total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE month_number >= 5
    AND calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
  GROUP BY calendar_year, week_number
),
before_june15 AS (
  SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    SUM(total_sales) as before_sales
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE week_number IN (21, 22, 23, 24)
  GROUP BY calendar_year
),
after_june15 AS (
  SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    SUM(total_sales) as after_sales
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE week_number IN (26, 27, 28, 29)
  GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT 
  b.calendar_year,
  b.before_sales,
  a.after_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * (a.after_sales - b.before_sales) / b.before_sales, 2) as percent_change
FROM before_june15 b
JOIN after_june15 a ON b.calendar_year = a.calendar_year
ORDER BY b.calendar_year
